description: Use an AI actor generator to put a realistic face on your product ad. Upload one photo, pick a voice, and download a clip you can post today.
h1: AI Actor Generator for Realistic Product Ads
lead: Your shop's AI actor generator puts a realistic adult on camera for the next product ad. Pick a face that fits the buyer, and reuse that face on the ads you already run.

m2.h2: How to Make an AI Actor Ad in 3 Simple Steps
m2.lead: Upload a product photo, pick a voice, and post a tall phone video.

steps.sourceHint: One clear product photo is enough to start
steps.prompt: This is the moisturizer step I keep beside the sink.

items.d: Use one clear photo, or paste a product page link. Keep the whole product in the photo.
Choose an actor and a voice. Type the words, or let AI write them.
Add words on screen and a song from the song list, then post to TikTok, Facebook, or Instagram.

cta_title: Cast an AI Actor for the Next Ad
cta_lead: Choose a face and a voice, then make a product video from one photo. You see the credit cost before you start.

faq.q: What counts as an AI actor in these ads?
faq.a: An adult AI actor, built for ads, not a cartoon. You choose the face and write the line. Use the clip as your presenter. Do not treat it as a review from a buyer.

faq.q: How does a written line become a clip?
faq.a: Bring the product and the sentence you want said, then choose the face and voice. A 10-second vertical clip is 9:16 and costs 40 credits. That cost shows before you start.

faq.q: Where can I run an AI actor video?
faq.a: Wherever the product already appears. A shoe brand might run it as the paid ad, then keep a shorter cut on the product page. The file has no watermark.

faq.q: Can one AI actor explain a single feature?
faq.a: Yes. Point at the lamp's power button and say what it does, and keep that button in frame. The next render can repeat the explanation when you add a color.

faq.q: Can an AI actor front a training clip?
faq.a: Yes. Write the packing steps as a script, then change a sentence when the rule changes. A second language is another render of that same script.

faq.q: How does a shop keep one AI actor on social?
faq.a: Use one face often enough that people recognize the tote posts. When a line gets old, change the first sentence and post a fresh 9:16 cut.

faq.q: Can I pick the face, the voice, and the language separately?
faq.a: Yes. Choose the face and voice separately from the library, then write the line in the language you sell in. A cloned voice is allowed only when you have rights to the sample.

faq.q: Can I run the clip as a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark, and you can use the AI actor and voice in a paid ad. You still need rights to the product photo and to any voice sample you upload. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: What should we watch before we post?
faq.a: Follow the platform's disclosure rules when a label is required. Do not imitate a real person who never agreed. Hire a human when the job needs a specific living performer. Add prices to the file after you download it and can check every digit.
